violated_rule: Features at prediction month t must use only records with month <= t; the 12-month window has no upper bound and includes months after t.
evidence: Synthetic panel at t = 12: F03 (current through t, delinquent from t+1) gets max_dq_12m 8 instead of 0 and n_dq_months_12m 8 instead of 0; F09 (01 at exactly t+1) gets max_dq_12m 1 instead of 0. The future-invariance tests fail: features change when records after t are removed (truncation) or when statuses after t are changed (perturbation).
